verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs show conversion of PDFs, images and documents into Markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks, so LLM-ready structured output is clearly documented. No evidence shows that repeated headers, footers, page numbers or other page furniture are stripped, so the 'clean, noise-free' half of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: documented header/footer and page-furniture removal, evidence the output is designed for LLM consumption, independent or hands-on corroboration of output cleanliness.
